subject: Copywriting
title: The Endowment Effect in Trials
description: A quick win: understand The Endowment Effect in Trials.

hook.text: Once people own something, they value it more. Free trial emails that say 'Your account is ready' create instant.

buildup.text: Thaler's endowment effect: people demand more to give up an item than they'd pay to get it. Ownership inflates value.

discovery.text: Trial expiration emails work because ending the trial feels like loss: 'Your workspace and all your files will be.

twist.text: Smart onboarding creates endowment fast: upload your data, customize settings, invite your team.

climax.text: Email copy for trials should emphasize what's been built, not what will be gained.

punchline.text: They already own it. Remind them what they'd lose. That converts.

quiz.question: What is the endowment effect?
options: People value what they already own more highly
